brief:
The United States denied a visa to a priest from Bethlehem's Church of the Nativity who was scheduled to speak at an event in the US, Middle East Eye reported. The denial came despite the cleric's previous visits to America.

Munther Isaac, pastor of Christmas Lutheran Church in Bethlehem, also received a visa denial for a separate American event, according to the outlet. Isaac had traveled to the US on prior occasions.
dek: Bethlehem Church of the Nativity priest denied visa to speak at US event Submitted by Yasmine El-Sabawi on Thu, 11/12/2026 - 19:32 A visa was also denied to Christmas Lutheran Church pastor Munther Isaac for a separate event, despite previous visits to the US…
title: US denies visa to Bethlehem priest invited to speak at American event
